svg.aria-label: CivicLens 2.0 overview: role-based dashboard, per-complaint chat, paginated newsfeed, complaint lifecycle, new features and database tables.

g.text: Civic complaint management and community news platform (C# WinForms + SQL Server)
Report an issue and follow it to resolution.
Review every complaint and assign it.
Work assigned complaints, update status, chat.
Cover assigned complaints, chat with citizens.
Approve accounts and manage the whole system.
The street light is still off.
Each change is saved in StatusHistory and shown as a timeline on the complaint.
Rebuilt and extended solo on top of CivicLens v1.
